children: French healthcare provider Ramsay Generale de Sante
expects its revenue to grow by 2% to 3% in 2027, with a stable core profit margin compared to 2026, it said ahead of its capital markets day on Thursday.
The company expects its gross capital expenditure to average about 4% of revenue over fiscal years 2027 to 2029, it added in the press release.
